title: Gamemode Notifier
description: Notifies everyone on the server when someone changes their gamemode.
body:
Always worrying that a server owner might switch to creative to give themselves diamonds?

You don't have to anymore, Gamemode Notifier is going to notify everyone on server when someone switches their gamemode to creative.

Use `/isgnpresent` to check if Gamemode Notifier is present on the server.
